summary: Retest of 3 fixes from iteration_16. All 3 verified. FIX 1: a signed checkout.session.completed webhook with no local record reactivates an archived owner's company (8900->medium, 6000->startup, 14900->large), removes archived_at, inserts a payment_transactions doc with source='payment_link', and /api/jobs returns 200 again. FIX 2: an archived foreman lands on /app and sees the archived-locked panel; no redirect loop (one navigation), no toasts, URL stays put. FIX 3: for a trial owner, all plan buttons read 'Choose X' and are enabled; for the active owner (robinjones), Medium reads 'Current plan' and is disabled. Regression passed: the new-signup banner shows 15 days, and an archived owner is redirected to /app/membership with archived-banner and archived-notice. End to end: after a webhook for 14900, the archived owner and foreman are both unlocked (Large plan, dashboard loads).

minor.issue: No unique index on payment_transactions.session_id. A sequential replay is idempotent, because the second call finds the record and takes the _fulfil_payment path. But two concurrent Stripe retries could both miss find_one and insert twice.
Returns 402 for archived members. NotificationBell keeps polling it while the locked panel is shown. The error is swallowed silently (.catch), so this is only wasted requests.

ui_bugs.component: Archived owner: clicking a sidebar nav item (e.g. Jobs)
ui_bugs.issue: The redirect back to /app/membership works, but the target page mounts briefly and fires API calls that return 402. This produces a stack of red 'Your free trial has ended...' toasts (about 3 stacked). Also seen in iteration_16 as a minor issue. The non-owner path is fixed because Layout hides children, but the owner path does not.

action_items: Optional: add a unique index on payment_transactions.session_id (or use an upsert in _fulfil_payment_link) so concurrent webhook retries cannot insert twice.

Optional: for archived owners, don't render children (or skip the 402 toast) on non-membership routes, so the redirect happens without stacked 402 toasts. Do the same in Layout for owners on non-membership paths.
Optional: skip NotificationBell polling when company.membership_status === 'archived'.
critical_code_review_comments: _fulfil_payment_link matches the payer by email against owners only. If someone pays with a different email, nothing is activated and only a warning is logged; no admin alert is raised.

The amount-to-plan inference depends on monthly prices being unique. It is fine now, but it will break if prices change or if coupons or taxes change amount_total. The fallback to the line_items lookup_key is good.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ companies, users and cs_test_link_* transactions during the run; all deleted by id or email afterwards. No seed data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_iter17_fixes.py. Its signed_post helper builds a valid Stripe-Signature header using a manual HMAC of the STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Login testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit-btn. Register testids: register-name, register-company, register-email, register-password, register-submit-btn. setup_archived_ui.py creates an archived owner and foreman (passwords TrialPass1! and FmPass123!). The UI plan buttons go to static buy.stripe.com payment links.
